title: Evaluations: judge dives and collect community scores
body: A new Evaluations tab opens a full-screen judging stage with a 3-second intro, a 0 to 10 score pad by half points, an optional comment and the community panel revealed after your confirmed score. Owners collect received scores with the jury comments; a closed evaluation keeps the panel but removes replay. Judges never see the dive outside Evaluations and every score stays immutable.
